title: How other docs sites build a releases page
shortDescription: Survey of Starlight changelog plugins, real open-source releases pages and GitHub's release-publish trigger, as of 2026-11-23

title: Spike: redeploying the docs when a release is published
shortDescription: Ran on a throwaway public repo on 2026-11-23. A release-published workflow that dispatches deploy-docs on main works; a direct tag-ref deploy is rejected; CI's contents-read token never sees drafts

title: Spike: starlight-changelogs on Ang's docs site
shortDescription: Built starlight-changelogs 0.7.2 into a copy of Ang's docs against the real repo on 2026-11-23; works with one npm override, empty until v1.0.0, doubled h1 from the notes, a visible draft would break the parse (CI's token can't see them)

shortDescription: The three files that differ from docs/ when starlight-changelogs 0.7.2 is added, and how to rerun the spike
